stories.title: Boy’s life saved on Saltney street after bike fall, Cheshire Police say
stories.summary: A boy who suffered a suspected arterial bleed after falling from his bike in Saltney was kept alive by four passers-by and four police officers, Cheshire Constabulary has said. stories.title: Twenty-two social rent flats proposed for former Flint Working Men’s Club site
stories.summary: Twenty-two flats for social rent are proposed on the site of Flint’s former Working Men’s Club, which has stood empty since it was demolished around 2009. stories.title: Dee Estuary cockling rules face first rewrite in 18 years
stories.summary: The rules controlling who can gather cockles on the Dee Estuary are to be rewritten, with 54 licensed gatherers working under an order that expires in June 2028. stories.title: Hawarden now holds two of Wales’s biggest heat records after Met Office verification
stories.summary: Hawarden recorded the hottest June day ever in Wales, the Met Office has confirmed, with 35.1C on 26 June now verified as a national record. The figure was confirmed in a Met Office release published on Wednesday, following the verification process the service runs on any provisional record. It beats the previous Welsh June record
